integrity: General proof is analytic. Exact-rational tests are supplementary, not a proof of infinite parameter claims. Related exponential-mixture uniqueness and Prony inversion are acknowledged prior techniques. Historical priority is provisional.
scientific_limitations: Identification is structural from exact full binary-history probabilities. Requires a known finite number of positive detection classes, conditionally independent Poisson visits with known durations, closed sites, and no false positives; finite-sample stability is not established.
title: Sharp visit complexity for heterogeneous-detection occupancy surveys with unequal efforts
